incidents.summary: CVS admitted unauthorised access to some IT systems that disrupted its UK operations, reported the incident to the Information Commissioner’s Office and subsequently restored IT services to most practices.

sources.title: Vet group CVS warns over risk to personal information in cyber-attack
sources.quote: CVS Group said hackers had gained unauthorised external access to a limited number of its IT systems.

sources.title: CVS suffered cyberattack while without a head of IT security
sources.quote: CVS Group revealed on Monday that it recently had detected and responded to an incident that it believes will disrupt its operations in Britain for weeks.

sources.title: CVS suffered cyberattack while without a head of IT security
sources.quote: CVS says IT services have been securely restored to the majority of its veterinary practices

positives: CVS introduced a zero-tolerance policy allowing practices to bar abusive clients or pursue legal action to protect staff.
CVS introduced discretionary sick pay of up to eight weeks at full pay for exceptional health events, available to colleagues with at least six months’ continuous service.
CVS introduced reusable sharps bins across its UK practices to reduce single-use waste.
